entities.name: Maurice Raynaud
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Auguste Gabriel Maurice Raynaud was the French medical doctor who discovered Raynaud syndrome, a vasospastic disorder which contracts blood vessels in extremities and is the "R" in the CREST syndrome acronym, in the late 19th century.
